notes.title: Hotfix 0.14.8
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]What an incredible launch! We're blown away by the response and the peak of [b]over 7,500 concurrent players[/b]. The amount of feedback we've received has been massive, and we're working hard to sort through it all. We're happy with how things are going and are [b]already working on further updates[/b] while monitoring all reviews, discord and ingame bug reports.[/p][p]Of course, no launch is perfect. We've been working hard to address the most critical issues that popped up, and this patch includes [b]fixes[/b] for some of the [b]most pressing problems.[/b][/p][p][b]Thank you[/b] for being part of this journey with us. We're excited to continue building the game alongside our amazing player community![/p][p][/p][h3]Patch Notes[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Rat performance:[/b] Addressed an issue where rat performance would get progressively worse with higher weapon damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Effect Density:[/b] The "Effect Density" graphics setting now also applies to throwables.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Crashes:[/b] Fixed crashes that occurred during intense moments with lots of projectiles and effects on screen.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Freezes:[/b] Fixed major freezes that could occur when interacting with loot spots in high-load scenarios.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Kola Zombie Attraction:[/b] The President Knabe character's unique ability now works as intended, with zombies being attracted to only one Kola trap. Previously, being drawn to multiple traps at once caused their movement to be erratic or unpredictable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI Navigation:[/b] Fixed a bug where quickly pausing twice in the inventory could break navigation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Movement:[/b] Resolved an issue where a player's movement could become stuck after rapidly clicking on a world Point of Interest (POI) in the base.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Explosion Telegraph:[/b] Fixed the visual telegraph for barrels.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Incremental upgrades:[/b] Updated the in-game text for upcoming incremental upgrades. These will be added in future Early Access updates.[/p][/*][/list][p]Share your thoughts and feeback with us and the community on our [url="https://discord.gg/6uDQSVeBxp"]discord[/url]. You can even submit tickets directly to us via [url="https://open.codecks.io/deadlydaysroadtrip"]opendecks[/url] discord bot. [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your support, feedback and patience,[/p][p]Team Pixelsplit [/p]

notes.title: One Week until EA Launch: 1000 Reviews + 96% positive 😱
notes.content:
[p]Dear survivors, [/p][h3][b]Deadly Days: Roadtrip[/b] is launching next week.[/h3][p]The [b]Early Access [/b]version will contain a ton of upgrades, content and chaos. A lot has been fixed, optimized and improved. But see for yourself next [b]Monday[/b], [b]Septembe[/b]r,[b] 22[/b]..   [/p][p][/p][h1]1k+ Reviews, overwhelmingly positive[/h1][p]We don't have words for the absolutely [b]amazing support[/b] we received [b]from our community[/b] on spreading the word about our demo. We're super proud and excited about the positive reviews on our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3102400/Deadly_Days_Roadtrip_Demo"]Demo[/url] and confident, that the Early Access version will exceed expectations. [/p][p]By the way: The [b]progress[/b] of things you unlock in the Demo [b]will be transferred[/b] to the main game as soon as we release![/p][p][/p][h1]What happens until launch? [/h1][p]At the moment our beloved community is adding feedback and ideas from the closed beta to our [url="https://open.codecks.io/deadlydaysroadtrip/"]Opendecks[/url] ticket system. If you want to gain some [b]insights[/b] on how the roadmap for early access could look like, definitely check that out.[/p][p]On [url="https://open.codecks.io/deadlydaysroadtrip/"]Opendecks[/url] you can [b]upvote[/b] cards and [b]submit own ideas[/b] on our [url="https://discord.gg/x4g6YpHwSk"]discord channel[/url]. Use the Decky Bot on the channel and submit your reports (/bug /idea /feedback). You will get notified automatically, when the dev team implemented the feature or has a question. That's pretty cool, right?[/p][p][/p][h1]What can you expect in the full Early Access version? [/h1][previewyoutube="zhW41n5TLV8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]A little preview of what you can expect in the full version of the game. We showed this trailer at Gamescom 2025. The feedback we got there was great, and we were happy to see everyone who stopped by. [/p][p][b]Early Access Content:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]55 Items (including 16 unique weapons, not counting the backpack tiles)[/p][/*][*][p]8 Bioms for over 16+ procedurally generated maps[/p][/*][*][p]7 Enemy Types [/p][/*][*][p]5 playable Characters (+ 1 secret character)[/p][/*][*][p]6 Powerups[/p][/*][*][p]3 Bosses[/p][/*][*][p]2 Special events and[/p][/*][*][p]1 Bananaperson [/p][/*][/list][p]We want to take this [b]roadtrip[/b] with the community riding shotgun. Early Access lets us test new ideas, see which builds, items and survivors people love or break the most and keep shaping the game together with the communty.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]The final version will have more content of everything: playable characters, items, maps, bosses and ways to push your runs to absurd levels. We’ll also polish the core loop and add more features and late-game variety based on feedback.[/p][p][/p][h1]New here?[/h1][p]If you have just discovered our game, we would recommend that you try it out for yourself. Grab our demo while it's still available!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3102400/Deadly_Days_Roadtrip_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h1]What else?[/h1][p]Big thanks to our community once again for their support. Your bug reports, ideas and reactions help us a lot in the development of Deadly Days: Roadtrip.[/p][p]
Your Team Pixelsplit  [/p]

notes.title: Playtest #5 LIVE
notes.content:
Hi Survivors!

We're back with another update! A lot of your feedback from the last playtest has been poured into this version, and we're happy to announce a new, focused Demo Playtest starting NOW!

This is a big step towards our official Demo release, so your input over the next few days is [b]incredibly important[/b]. This playtest will be a short one, running until this upcoming Sunday, May 25th. So jump in, break things (metaphorically!), and tell us everything!

Take a look at our [url=https://open.codecks.io/deadlydaysroadtrip/decks/138-roadmap]Roadmap [/url]and [url=https://open.codecks.io/deadlydaysroadtrip]Open Decks[/url]. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/WZE8RUXhyu]Discord[/url] to discuss ideas and participate in our giveaways. Apart from that, it would be really great if you could take a few minutes to fill out our feedback form (in-game).

[h3]Now Speaking Your Language! (maybe)[/h3]
Now available for even more survivors around the globe! We've added initial support for:
[list]
[*] French
[*] Spanish
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] Ukrainian
[*] Russian
[/list]
Additionally, we’ve included an initial translation for Simplified [b]Chinese[/b]. Please note: this is currently an machine-translation. A full, handcrafted localization will follow soon, but we wanted to give our Chinese-speaking players a chance to jump in early!

[h3]The Workbench & New Unlocks![/h3]
Get ready to put that hard-earned [b]Duct Tape[/b] to good use!

Head to your meta base to find the [b]new Workbench[/b], your go-to spot for powerful One-Time Unlocks:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/08d5e2cf19df081fc539dd15415ec3f9636d588d.png[/img]

We also added the possibility to unlock rerolls, giving you more control over your runs:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/9343e01fe4a6b495d5d331cedf341b4e3561ff78.png[/img]

[b]ATTENTION VETERAN PLAYTESTERS:[/b] We've streamlined the initial item pool. To get access to the full range of gear you might be used to, be sure to [b]unlock[/b] the new[b] Item Packs[/b] via the Workbench!

[h3]The MKing Must Fall![/h3]
The boss encounter has been completely revamped for a more epic showdown. The boss now features all-new animations, bringing the fight to life like never before.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/21217eb9e047ea9e2086f476e4ede3fea9894365.gif[/img]

Prepare to face this monstrous threat at the iconic MKing Burger location, which you might now from Deadly Days 1.

[h3]Rebalancing the Apocalypse![/h3]
We've dug deep into game balance to refine the challenge and progression:
[list]
[*] The number of enemies and their threat level should now progress more smoothly throughout your runs. Be warned:[b] Normal enemies are now more dangerous![/b]
[*] We've significantly [b]improved[/b] how loot, and especially crucial fuel, is distributed across the entire map. No more barren patches (hopefully!).
[*] Early in your character's journey, you'll find fewer high-rarity items. As you level up, your chances of scoring that sweet epic loot will increase.
[*] Several [b]weapons[/b] have been [b]rebalanced[/b]. Most notably, the Rocket Launcher can now PIERCE enemies AND BOUNCE to new targets! Boom!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/ee0384349a7d4089c67c8075d444afffc109110e.gif[/img]
[*] We've made sure that lingering on a map for too long becomes significantly more perilous. You'll know when it's time to go.
[/list]
[h3]Performance, Stability & Critical Fixes[/h3]
Beyond the big features, we've focused on making the game run smoother and more reliably. The performance has been improved a bit, the stability increased across the board and a lot of bugs have been fixed.

[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added: More onboarding hints via your character's speech bubble to help new players.
[*] Added: Flavor texts for items! Discover a bit more lore and personality.
[*] Added: A "Zombie Flesh" setting in the options. This can reduce the number of body parts on screen, which may help with visual clutter or performance on some systems.
[*] Improved: Throwable items (like grenades) and powerups are now brighter and have an outline, making them much more visible in the chaos.
[*] Improved: When you place a bag from airdrop rewards, you can now select another reward, and the previously placed bag will be conveniently returned to the selection.
[*] Improved: The inventory is now accessible from the pause menu (Read-Only).
[*] Improved: The framerate setting is now hidden if VSync is active, preventing conflicts.
[*] Improved: Loot spots now have clear range indicators.
[*] Improved: A very slight delay has been added after closing the airdrop screen, giving you a moment to reorient yourself.
[*] Improved: Loading speeds should be noticeably better.
[*] Improved: Item texts regarding how they trigger have been clarified.
[*] Improved: Runner enemies now have a more visible telegraph for their attacks.
[*] Improved: Fewer bullets should now be blocked by small, insignificant destructible objects.
[*] Balancing: Melee weapons with extended range now intelligently clamp their attack to the targeted enemy's distance, ensuring you hit what you're aiming at, not the air behind them!
[*] Balancing: The Spring item has been reworked! It now grants +1 dash for each marked footwear item you have equipped.
[*] Balancing: Runner enemy attack range has been reduced.
[*] Balancing: The Rubber Ball's bouncing projectile now seeks out the nearest enemy instead of a random one.
[*] Balancing + Fix: The "Socks + Rollerblades" combo was... a bit wild. We've addressed this and also nerfed Rollerblades a tad in general. During this, we found and fixed a bug where Socks + Fireshoes weren't working correctly – try them out now!
[*] Balancing: The sky's the limit (theoretically) – there's no longer a hard cap on the Robot Arm's effect.
[*] Balancing: Katana attack rate has been nerfed.
[*] Fixed: The "Finger Length" (loot radius) upgrade wasn't working. It is now!
[*] Fixed: The music volume setting was not being respected during airdrop sequences.
[*] Fixed: Your character will no longer continue dashing if you dash directly into a base POI or an airdrop.
[*] Fixed: Jumper zombies will no longer drop their loot mid-air where you can't reach it.
[*] Fixed: Item rotation could behave erratically on machines with lower-end integrated graphics cards.
[*] Fixed: Airdrops could sometimes create a ring around the player, blocking pathfinding and making you untouchable by enemies.
[*] Fixed: Addressed several controller usability issues.
[*] Fixed: Nailed several crash-inducing bugs!
[*] Naming Consistency: Naming: The stat "Deviation" has been renamed to "Spread" for better clarity.
[/list]

How does that sound to you? Write it in the comments, play a few rounds and let us know if your expectations were met. 

You can also follow us on [url=instagram.com/pixelsplitgames/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/pixelsplit.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url] and [url=https://x.com/pixelsplitgames]Twitter[/url].

And join our [url=https://discord.gg/WZE8RUXhyu]Discord[/url] if you want to actively participate in the further development. We are looking forward to it!

Until then, have a nice apocalypse,
your team Pixelsplit

notes.title: End of open playtest round #4
notes.content:
Hello survivors,

today our playtest round #4 is ending. Thank you so much for taking part. We received over 3.000 completed feedback forms and at times had over 400 players at the same time. Almost 100 ideas were added to opendecks by the community and on top of that we received almost 500 ingame submissions. Feel free to [url=https://open.codecks.io/deadlydaysroadtrip]take a look[/url].

We are very pleased that the gameplay experience was already smooth and stable for the vast majority of you – this is great validation for our work so far. At the same time, we are grateful for the reports of crashes and other issues that some players encountered. This is precisely the purpose of a playtest: to identify these hurdles early on and iron them out, ensuring the demo and the full release offer an even better experience.

Thanks to your help, we were able to deploy a total of five patches and hotfixes during the testing phase. Our primary focus was on improving stability and performance, but we also implemented requested quality-of-life enhancements such as map stats on the loading screen, inventory access at the merchant and an overhaul for the item tooltips.

notes.title: Playtest #4 LIVE
notes.content:
Hi survivors,

today we are releasing our fourth playtest for “[b]Deadly Days: Roadtrip[/b]”. It has been a bit over 3 months and a [b]LOT[/b] has changed. More than we can fit into these notes. Thanks to everyone who participated in the previous playtest for your feedback. We are curious to hear what you think of the changes that we have implemented.

The most important thing first: Go to the store page and [b]sign up for the playtest[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3026450/Deadly_Days_Roadtrip/

Enjoy the game and [b]share your thoughts [/b]with us afterwards! There are two ways to do so:
[olist]
[*] Using the [b]feedback form[/b] built into the game.
[*] Directly via our [url=https://discord.gg/WZE8RUXhyu]Discord[/url] server in our new submission channel.
[/olist]

[h1]Reworked mission system[/h1]
The whole [b]mission system[/b] has been [b]reworked[/b]. We now divide the map into "biomes". Each biome can have its own type of mission. Later we want to add more gameplay around this system (e.g. biome specific enemy types). In this process we also completeley redesigned the [b]mission selection map[/b]:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/a00c4913301b92a29a3f706251da9f31533c947a.png[/img]

We have also added a mechanic to add events between two days. For now, we added[b] a merchant[/b] you can randomly find and buy some items to improve your build. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/63d24a4db3da4dc8a212bbb057ba4bc1517bccbe.png[/img]

In the process, we also changed the way you get scrap: it now drops randomly on the maps, so you better pick it up.

We also added a more [b]dangerous encounter[/b] in the middle of the road trip. You will notice it.

[h1]New content[/h1]
We added [b]two new enemy types[/b] (the jumper and the sneaky one). Jumper preview:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/2ff5525590c9caf144a78ae92793f85b6c0ed8c6.gif[/img]

We also added [b]two new items[/b] (Rubber Ball and Battery). Battery preview:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/8b54232a39e68d45a2b1c623e9d69920015af8d2.gif[/img]

[h1]Strengthening of the infrastructure[/h1]
A major focus for this new version was the refinement of the game's fundamentals and infrastructure.

We added [b]full controller support [/b]to the game and [b]improved performance[/b]. This allows the game to be played on [b]Steamdeck[/b].

We also added a [b]new settings menu[/b] with full input mapping, but also [b]accessibility [/b]options like a non-pixelated font and automatic use of powerups. Feel free to customize the game to your needs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/4fcd1cb765d3a76ec6dd840e1334b8768851b2a6.gif[/img]

We also switched to DirectX11 for now, we had several issues with DirectX12. But if you are brave, you can optionally choose the unstable DirectX12 option. This might give you better graphics, but may crash occasionally. Give us a feedback if you dare to try it.

[h1]Visual overhaul[/h1]
There was a strong initiative to rework the game visually as well. All the [b]UI screens[/b] were redesigned, we added cool transition animations, etc.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/03995156977bc27b5973fd4743c53e342384f267.gif[/img]

We also added more variety to the [b]map generation[/b] and ground textures to make the visual appearance more vivid. Another neat detail of many is the increasing wetness of the map when it rains.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/a779f894c3405ced91afa08ea9bec49e8e7718e0.gif[/img]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
We have made several changes to the balance of the game. Overall, it [b]should be harder[/b] now, but [b]hopefully not too hard [/b]for new players. Please give us feedback about this!

Here is an incomplete list of balance changes:
[list]
[*] Normal enemies now attack faster and are generally more aggressive, don't get too close to them!
[*] Days are longer now, but the night becomes more and more dangerous (up to the point where the threat level increases every second)
[*] Complete overhaul of how fire and poison work. Poison for example weakens over time, but is stackable now:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/475d2a6a4c915356e1438874ada9e6fd5e5703c4.gif[/img]
[*] Player debuff speed when damaged
[*] Banana item explodes on bounce and is reduced by 1 bounce
[*] Boss health doubled
[*] Explosive powerup now scales with player level
[*] Epic weapons + throwables do more damage
[*] Barrels do -50% damage to player
[*] More fuel on maps, especially large maps
[*] Player speed increased slightly
[*] Some more invincibility frames after dash and opening airdrop
[*] Slower growth of max enemies, enemy speed and enemy health
[*] Easier to craft some recipes (requires lower rarities)
[/list]

[h1]What else?[/h1]
As mentioned at the beginning, we were only able to cover some of the changes and improvements in these notes. We have documented 835 changes in our Github since the last playtest. 

That being said, we would like to point out the following:
[olist]
[*] We want to offer a transparent insight into the development of 'Deadly Days: Roadtrip' through [url=https://open.codecks.io/deadlydaysroadtrip]Open Decks[/url]. Your bug reports and suggestions for improvement will appear there and you can keep track of the tickets we are working on.
[*] We are hosting giveaways for the full version of the game with exciting challenges for the community. Feel free to drop by and take part!
[*] This playtest will probably be the [b]last open playtest[/b]. If you are interested in continuing to help with the development, stay active on our [url=https://discord.gg/WZE8RUXhyu]Discord[/url] and we will reach out to you personally.
[/olist]

We also updated our trailer:
[previewyoutube=MoVE_pwvurw;full][/previewyoutube]

Deadly Days: Roadtrip is an exciting action roguelite, that combines reverse bullet hell gameplay with strategic inventory management.

Start your road trip through the zombie apocalypse! Fight your way through, gain experience and collect items to assemble an epic inventory. Craft more effective weapons and find out what items you can combine to withstand the ever-increasing waves of zombies.

notes.title: Playtest #3 starting today!
notes.content:
Hello,

today we're launching the public playtest round 3 for our upcoming game “Deadly Days: Roadtrip”. We would be delighted if you would take a look at it and give us your feedback. 

If you have already been to the first rounds, you will certainly notice [i]some[/i] changes. In addition to some exciting new items and objects on the map, you can now get a first look at two brand new game mechanics: Active Power-Ups and Meta Progress. 

[h3]Active Power-Ups[/h3]
We created a new system for our power-ups (previous health pickup, vacuum, dynamite etc.). Before the change they automatically consumed. Now you can collect them and use them when needed by pressing the keys 1-4. An important strategic tool in the fight against the zombies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/a0e8e6da3c24ee83b91490b8147ead7e263e0fa2.gif[/img]

There are also new items that exploit this new design space.

Small remark: QoL-wise we decided that the health power-up and level up power up instantly consume. If you have full health though then the health powerup will be slotted.

[h3]Meta progression[/h3]
Depending on how far you get in a run, you will now receive a valuable meta currency that you can use to improve your stats. This means you not only gain game experience over time, but can also improve your initial stats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/5d2a4be42619a529d41e72a0a8bd92452b82a10d.gif[/img]

[h3]Tech Update[/h3]
Under the hood, we upgraded from Unreal Engine 5.4 to Unreal Engine 5.5 and re-integrated our entire sound design using FMOD. In the process, we have also integrated an extensive and varied soundtrack into the game, which adapts to the danger level. Take a look at the audio options, as these have also been refined in the process.

We have also been able to significantly improve performance in some areas.

If your hardware is a bit outdated, we recommend that you select the DirectX 11 version when starting the game. Feel free to compare both versions and write your experiences here in the comments, the discussion forums or on our Discord.

[h3]Inventory UX improvements[/h3]
Inventory management is a central component of the game. We have made some progress here. Take a look at the snapping of the items and the item affection visualization.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/7201a6b84a9de90087442eca220dea19c20b4f81.gif[/img]

[h3]Other changes[/h3]
[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] [spoiler]New magnet item (increases loot range)[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Craftable rocket launcher
[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]New "utility belt" item which increases powerup slots[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]2 new "active powerup" items which permanently give you an ability[/spoiler]
[*] New "energy drink" powerup (faster stamina regeneration)
[*] New soundtrack incl. new boss fight music
[/list]
[b]Improved[/b]
[list]
[*] Barrels explode on second hit now, not directly on first hit. They also blink for a short period before exploding
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/803069de2d5a4119f018ac7591df24dc9e9a47c3.gif[/img]
[*] Player damage feedback now scaling with damage received
[*] Tackle enemy more predictable now (arrow scales and rotates towards player and then locks in and gets red)
[*] Reworked boss map visuals to fit farm theme
[*] Boss map gates open and close automatically now (not physics based anymore)
[*] Fuel automatically absorbed after beating boss and bus near to entrance now
[*] More vehicle types on maps
[*] Reworked character portraits
[*] Reworked day end and win / loose screens
[*] Manual shooting can also be triggered with CTRL key
[/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Some tiles on map not generated (black holes)
[*] Many inventory related bugs
[*] Airdrop and some loot crates spawned outside of player-reachable area
[*] Some lakes did block bullets
[*] Game starting way before loading screen ended
[/list]
[b]Balanced[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced base loot range (but you can buff it alot with magnet item and meta upgrades)
[*] Reduced stamina regen rate (so you can't constantly dash cross the map)
[*] Loot is distributed more evenly among lootspots (hopefully not completing fuel by just looting one car)
[*] Generally more lootspots, especially in forest maps (e.g. tents)
[/list]

We definitely forgot something in this list, but you'll see for yourself :)

notes.title: Playtest #2 starting today!
notes.content:
Hello,

today we're launching the public playtest round 2 for our upcoming game “[b]Deadly Days: Roadtrip[/b]”. We would be delighted if you would take a look at it and give us your feedback. 

If you have already been to round 1, you will certainly notice some changes. Thanks for all your valuable feedback! That is what we need!

Sign up on our storepage:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3026450/Deadly_Days_Roadtrip/

If you want a chance to [b]win a key[/b] for the full version of Deadly Days: Roadtrip, use the feedback form and enter our [b]new monthly giveaways[/b]. 

[h1]What is new?[/h1]

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Use our new mission selection map to choose your route for each run. You'll find some [b]new maps[/b] there. 
[*] [b]Baloon Pump[/b] Item - you can use this to craft powerful melee and ranged weapons, like this inflated Katana sword ːsteammockingː
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/30f4ace30e07e33b5e0d752b1c23733a0fca69aa.gif[/img]
[*] There are now [b]3 characters[/b] in the game, which can be unlocked. In addition to the Survivor, who has an expanded starting inventory, you can now unlock Bananaperson and the Sheriff, who each bring a [b]special item[/b] with them. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/62413d72cdcd0ce82fe5fbaa270b999cf5943b74.gif[/img]
[*] Mini fuel UI next to the character to give you feedback where you need it
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/c9d39acb408246193fb0bf712ef09c8c5e26596d.gif[/img]
[*] Direction indicator for the bus when you have collected enough fuel to return.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/d6f9a704f030ec20f11f5e6741f06863b12fb06a.gif[/img]
[*] A look at our upcoming "Meta Base". This will be your starting screen, which you will improve throughout all your runs (right now you can switch characters and start the mission there).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/6d66fc027a09bdd4926505d83a45cd3c8b5e0a61.gif[/img]
[*]When you hover over items, you can see which items are affected.
[*] Current status of our new soundtrack
[*] There are now [b]explosive objects[/b], such as barrels, with which you can cause a lot of damage - but be careful, you are not immune to these explosions. 
[*]Ingame Feedback / Bug Report. It also sends a screenshot of the game so we know what you are talking about. (Please use it!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/6df1646fa5de03f686c458ce3872931f3fd91477.gif[/img]
[/list]

[b]Improved[/b]
[list]
[*] Item loot can now be found in every loot spot. However, loot crates contain guaranteed items.
[*] Items can now be upgraded by dragging and dropping.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/d4f027b1b8bd21be1b48a271cd6a6f69228c7934.gif[/img]
[*] Items will now automatically be de-equipped when you overlap an item (and an item will automatically be attached to your mouse when you overlap / auto-unequip)
[*] Light shadows for items being dragged around
[*] Tooltip when you need to reduce the amount of items in your stash.
[*] Reworked hand displays
[*] Reworked a lot of the zombie sprites + new wobble animations
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/291f7312c8c7fa18c55c779d5559b38edd421e6b.gif[/img]
[*] Reworked dash visuals
[*] Performance improvements here and there
[*] New map for boss fight
[*] Experience orb animations
[*] Feedback when activating bus with insufficient fuel
[*] Buffed Health Kit item (reduced delay + now accumulates damage before healing)
[*] Lots of balance tweaks here and there
[*] You can now use arrow keys to control your character (besides WASD)
[*] Dashing now has less friction and should feel smoother
[*] Runner zombie line telegraph now RED for better visibility
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Crashes when playing long sessions with a lot of inventory rearrangement
[*] Many issues with robot arm and dumbell (hands not counting, stuff not equipping, etc.)
[*] Map generation sometimes fails (black holes in map)
[*] Airdrop items sometimes under airdrop crate in reward screen
[*] Throwables sometimes didn't explode
[*] Blablabla popup sometimes appears when dashing
[*] Manual shoot sometimes not working when at map border
[*] Player could dash out of map sometimes
[*] Some typos
[/list]

We definitely forgot something in this list, but you'll see for yourself :)

If you want a chance to win a key for the full version of Deadly Days: Roadtrip, use the feedback form and enter our new monthly giveaways.

[h1]About the game: [/h1]

Deadly Days: Roadtrip is an exciting action roguelite, that combines reverse bullet hell gameplay with strategic inventory management.

Start your road trip through the zombie apocalypse! Fight your way through, gain experience and collect items to assemble an epic inventory. Craft more effective weapons and find out what items you can combine to withstand the ever-increasing waves of zombies.

Have fun playing the game.

notes.title: Open Playtest Round 1 closed - Registration for Round 2 is open
notes.content:
Hi,

First of all, we'd like to thank all the players who took part in our first public playtest. We received great, helpful, constructive feedback. Registration for round 2 is open - just use the button on our store page.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3026450/Deadly_Days_Roadtrip/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/cd0795ad0f60dbc0b7fef02eec30bf9827d0aa21.png[/img][/url]


[h2]When will round 2 of the playtest start?[/h2]
We are now working hard on new features and content. Based on your feedback, the next version will include some improvements. Round 2 of the playtest should start at the beginning of October. It's best to join our [url=https://discord.gg/6uDQSVeBxp]Discord[/url] so you don't miss anything. 

[h2]What changes and new content will there be in round 2 of the playtest?[/h2]
We don't want to give anything away just yet, but we can say that we have already implemented some cool features and improvements that we are currently testing internally. We still need to fix a few bugs and ensure stability so that there are no frustrating crashes or similar in the open playtest.

[h2]What was the feedback from round 1 of the playtest?[/h2]
The game was well received by both the online players and the players on site at gamescom, and most of them enjoyed it. We are very happy about that. But even more important are the many little things you mentioned. If we continue to receive such high-quality feedback, we can create a great game together.

So thank you for that, if you want to stay up to date, make sure you follow the store page and join our [url=https://discord.gg/6uDQSVeBxp]Discord[/url].

Best regards,
